_comment: ========================================================================== Desktop Companion — English interface strings Fallback chain: current language -> Chinese -> the key itself. Missing keys are not fatal; the key name is shown instead. ==========================================================================

strings.app.name: Desktop Companion
strings.app.welcome: Hi, I'm your desktop companion. Double-click me to type a command, right-click for the menu. Try "open browser" or "help".
strings.app.result.not_understood: I didn't understand that. Say "help" to see what I can do.
strings.app.error.no_router: The command module isn't ready, so commands can't run right now. Check the diagnostics page.
strings.app.voice.unavailable: Voice input isn't available right now. Check Settings for the reason, or just type instead.
strings.app.hotkey.partial_failure: {count} hotkey(s) failed to register (another program may be using them). You can still use the tray menu.
strings.app.startup.degraded: {count} feature(s) started in degraded mode. See the Diagnostics tab in Settings.
strings.app.quit.while_recording:
A recording is in progress. Quitting will stop it first.

Quit anyway?
strings.tray.tooltip.reload_rules: Re-read the rule files under resources/commands — no restart needed
strings.tray.disabled.speech_off: Voice is disabled. Enable it in Settings → Voice & Recording.
strings.tray.disabled.recording_off: Recording is disabled. Enable it in Settings → Voice & Recording.
strings.tray.unavailable.no_service: This system has no usable tray service (possibly no desktop environment). The app still works — right-click the pet window instead.
strings.input.placeholder: Type a command, e.g. open browser / search weather / translate hello
strings.input.hint.empty: Please type something (press Esc to close).
strings.input.hint.too_long: Too long (max {max} characters). Please shorten it.
strings.perm.title: Confirm operation
strings.perm.impact.minimal: No system settings changed; no effect on other programs
strings.perm.elevation.notice: This needs administrator rights. The system may show a security prompt for you to decide — this app will not elevate on your behalf. If you'd rather not continue, click Deny.
strings.perm.ack.irreversible: I understand this cannot be undone and cannot be recovered by this app
strings.perm.ack.batch: Note: this is a batch operation affecting several targets at once. Please double-check the scope.
strings.perm.scope.label: Grant scope
strings.perm.scope.session: Allow this action for this session
strings.perm.scope.permanent: Always allow this action (revocable in Settings)
strings.perm.tooltip.need_ack: Please tick the confirmation box above first
strings.perm.tooltip.forbidden: This kind of operation is not permitted and cannot be granted
strings.recorder.title: Recording
strings.recorder.banner.local_only: Recordings stay on your computer. This app does not upload them and will not send them to any service without your permission.
strings.recorder.banner.unavailable: Recording is not available right now.
strings.recorder.unavailable.service_missing: The recording module is not loaded.
strings.recorder.tooltip.start: Start recording (you'll be asked to confirm first)
strings.recorder.tooltip.purge: Delete recordings older than the retention period
strings.recorder.disabled.not_enabled: Recording is disabled. Turn it on in Settings → Voice & Recording.
strings.recorder.delete.title: Delete recording
strings.recorder.delete.confirm:
Delete "{name}"?

The file will be removed from disk.
strings.recorder.delete.permanent_confirm:
Permanently delete "{name}"?

This cannot be undone and the file cannot be recovered.
strings.recorder.purge.title: Purge by age
strings.recorder.purge.confirm:
This will delete all recordings older than {days} days.

This cannot be undone. Continue?
strings.recorder.purge.unlimited:
Retention is set to keep files forever, so there is nothing to purge.

You can set a retention period in Settings → History & Privacy.
strings.recorder.close.while_recording:
Recording is in progress. Closing this window will NOT stop the recording.

Close the window anyway?
strings.recorder.error.file_missing: The file no longer exists — it may have been moved or deleted. The list has been refreshed.
strings.recorder.error.play_failed: Could not play this file: no application on the system can open it.
strings.history.title: History
strings.history.search.invalid_range: The end time must be later than the start time.
strings.history.delete.title: Delete records
strings.history.delete.selected_confirm:
Delete the {count} selected record(s)?

This cannot be undone.
strings.history.delete.select_first: Please select the records to delete in the list first.
strings.history.delete.partial:
Deletion finished, but some entries failed.

Succeeded: {removed}, failed: {failed}.
strings.history.delete.range_confirm:
All records in "{category}" between {range} will be deleted.

This cannot be undone. Continue?
strings.history.clear.category_confirm:
This deletes every record in "{category}" and cannot be undone.

Type "{category}" to confirm:
strings.history.clear.all_confirm:
This deletes ALL history (conversations, tasks, translations, searches, recording metadata) and cannot be undone.

Type "{keyword}" to confirm:
strings.history.export.title: Export history
strings.history.stats.unavailable: The history database is unavailable, so recording is off. Chat and commands still work normally.
strings.history.stats.near_limit: Storage nearly full — consider cleaning up or raising the limit
strings.history.privacy.all_on: All five categories are currently recorded. Turning a category off means it produces no data at all.
strings.history.privacy.partial_off: These categories are turned off and therefore don't appear here: {categories}. Change this in Settings → History & Privacy.
strings.history.privacy.all_off: All history recording is off. No records are being produced. Re-enable in Settings → History & Privacy.
strings.history.unavailable.title: History unavailable
strings.history.unavailable.detail: The database could not be opened, so there is no history to show. Your conversations and commands are unaffected. See the log for details.
strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.settings.tooltip.export_no_secrets: Exports never include keys or credentials
strings.settings.general.language.label: Language
strings.settings.general.language.note: The interface updates immediately. Language files live under resources/i18n next to the program and can be edited directly.
strings.settings.startup.enabled: Start automatically when the system boots
strings.settings.startup.minimized: Start without showing the main window (tray only)
strings.settings.startup.unavailable: This system doesn't support configuring autostart automatically:
strings.settings.appearance.image.placeholder: Leave empty to use the built-in look
strings.settings.appearance.always_on_top: Always on top of other windows
strings.settings.appearance.start_hidden: Hide the pet on startup (tray only)
strings.settings.appearance.hints: Show status hints in the speech bubble
strings.settings.command.min_confidence.note: Below this value the app won't guess your intent — it lists candidates and asks you to pick.
strings.settings.command.confirm_medium: Ask for confirmation before medium-risk operations
strings.settings.command.authorize_high: Require explicit authorization for high-risk operations
strings.settings.command.risk.fixed_note: Note: high-risk operations always require your authorization and this protection cannot be turned off; "forbidden" operations have no execution path at all.
strings.settings.command.scripts: Allow rules to invoke external scripts
strings.settings.command.scripts.note: External scripts are off by default for safety. Enabling this lets rules call system scripts, at your own risk.
strings.settings.reload.with_errors: Rules reloaded ({count} total) but with these problems:
strings.settings.reload.unavailable: The command engine isn't ready, so rules can't be reloaded.
strings.settings.network.mode.note: Defaults to "Only allow enabled services": only the search or translation services you explicitly enabled may go online; nothing else connects.
strings.settings.network.ask_remember: Remember this session's choices (expires when the session ends)
strings.settings.network.max_retries.note: Capped at 3. The app never retries indefinitely.
strings.settings.network.tls.available: TLS 1.2 and above available; certificate validation is enabled.
strings.settings.network.tls.fixed_note: This app offers no "allow insecure connections" option. All network requests must pass certificate validation. This is intentional and cannot be changed.
strings.settings.speech.enabled.note: Voice is off by default. Once enabled, audio is captured only when you press the hotkey or click the voice button — the app is never always-listening.
strings.settings.speech.no_runtime: The core isn't running, so speech capability can't be probed.
strings.settings.speech.not_compiled: This build doesn't include the speech module, so related features are disabled. Text commands and the pet itself are unaffected.
strings.settings.speech.no_backend: No usable speech backend was found on this system, so voice features are disabled.
strings.settings.recording.enabled.note: Recording is off by default. Once enabled, you still have to start each recording yourself — the app never records automatically.
strings.settings.recording.local_only: Recordings are stored in the local data folder and are never uploaded.
strings.settings.recording.no_runtime: The core isn't running, so recording capability can't be probed.
strings.settings.recording.not_compiled: This build doesn't include the audio module, so recording is disabled.
strings.settings.recording.no_device: No usable microphone or audio input device was found.
strings.settings.history.categories.note: Turning a category off means it stops producing data entirely — it is not recorded but hidden.
strings.settings.history.retention_days.note: 0 means keep forever. Expired records are cleaned up when the app starts.
strings.settings.history.audit: Write an audit log of important operations
strings.settings.history.audit.note: The audit log records only the operation type, time, result and authorization state — never file contents.
strings.settings.history.privacy.commitment: This app reports nothing: no telemetry, no usage statistics, and your history or recordings are never sent to any server. All data stays on your own computer.
strings.settings.hotkey.note: If another program already owns a combination, registration fails and the app tells you at startup. Every feature remains reachable from the tray menu.
strings.settings.hotkey.unavailable: This system doesn't support global hotkeys:
strings.settings.diagnostics.external.note: These locations hold configuration, data, logs and the autostart entry. The app reads and writes nothing else. See docs/ENVIRONMENT_ISOLATION.md for details.
strings.settings.diagnostics.no_runtime: The core isn't running, so there are no diagnostics to show.
strings.settings.save.done:
Settings saved.

Some settings (interface language, animation parameters, permission policy) take full effect on the next start.
strings.settings.error.save_failed: Save failed. Please check that the config folder is writable.
strings.settings.error.no_runtime: The core isn't running, so settings can't be saved.
strings.settings.error.hotkey_conflict: Hotkey conflict: "{a}" and "{b}" use the same combination. Please change one of them.
strings.settings.close.unsaved:
You have unsaved changes.

Save before closing?
strings.settings.reset.title: Reset to defaults
strings.settings.reset.confirm:
This restores every setting to its default.

Your current configuration is backed up to the config folder first, so you can restore it manually.

Continue?
strings.settings.reset.done: Defaults restored. The previous configuration was backed up to the config folder.
strings.settings.import.title: Import configuration
strings.settings.import.has_errors: Errors were found while importing; some settings were not applied:
strings.settings.import.has_warnings: Import finished, but these items were adjusted:
strings.settings.export.title: Export configuration
